title: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream, 60ml
features: PDRN Daily Hydration: Formulated with PDRN derived from salmon DNA, this daily moisturizing cream helps maintain long-lasting hydration while supporting a healthy, natural glow
Lightweight Texture: A lightweight, fast-absorbing moisturizer that feels smooth on the skin—non-greasy and non-sticky, leaving a comfortable silky finish
No Pilling and Works Well with Makeup: Designed to work seamlessly under makeup, this hydrating cream never pills, making it suitable for daily AM/PM use
Non-Comedogenic Formula: Suitable for breakout-prone skin; non-comedogenic tested to help minimize pore clogging
How to Use: After cleansing and toning, apply an appropriate amount to the face and gently massage until fully absorbed. Use AM and PM as the final step of your skincare routine
Hyaluronic Acid Infused: Contains hyaluronic acid to help support skin moisture retention and maintain a smooth, supple appearance throughout the day
